# GitHub Codespaces

[GitHub Codespaces](https://github.com/features/codespaces) provides cloud-powered development environments for any activity - whether it's a long-term project, or a short-term task like reviewing a pull request. You can work with these environments from {% data variables.product.prodname_vscode %} or in a browser-based editor.
